## Muriel 1.2.6

**Downloads**
- **iPhone:** [ios-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/ios-latest) (`Muriel.ipa`, install with SideStore, AltStore or Sideloadly). Needs iOS 16.2 or newer
- **Android:** [android-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/android-latest) (`Muriel.apk`)
- **Windows:** installer below, or the portable exe on [windows-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/windows-latest)
- **macOS:** `.dmg` / `.zip` below, for Apple Silicon and Intel. The app is unsigned: if macOS blocks it, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
- **Linux:** `.AppImage` below (needs FUSE 2: `fuse2` / `libfuse2`)

Or get it from the website: https://cloverscripts.github.io/riff-muriel/

**New**
- **Share playlists:** the new Share button on a playlist makes a link. Anyone can open it in the browser with the new [web player](https://cloverscripts.github.io/riff-muriel/play/), no install needed, or add it to their own Muriel with Add to Muriel there, or by pasting the link into Muriel's search bar
- **Better sound quality:**
  - **Android:** YouTube songs now play as Opus (about 130 to 160 kbps) instead of 128 kbps AAC.
  - **Desktop:** playback and the Download button now get YouTube's best audio instead of a lower-quality copy.
- **SoundCloud on Android:** songs SoundCloud only offers as a stream (HLS) now play instead of failing. Thanks to [maxim1zz](https://github.com/maxim1zz) for the patch.
- **Save sound settings is on by default:** speed, pitch and effects stay the way you set them, also after restarting the app

Everything from 1.2.5 is included too: speed and pitch no longer reset when the next song starts, Download all favorites, download the songs you select, Play and Shuffle buttons, repeat in three steps and free sync between your devices.
